name: held-object
program:
from par6 import RobotClient
from waldoctl import Sphere
from waldo_commander.skills.attachments import attach_object, detach_object

with RobotClient() as rbt:
    rbt.set_shapes([Sphere(radius=0.01, name="part", pose=(1, 1, 0.3, 0, 0, 0))])
    attach_object(rbt, name="part", flange_pose=(0, 0, 0.3, 0, 0, 0))
    rbt.delay(0.2)
    detach_object(rbt, name="part", world_pose=(1, 1, 0.3, 0, 0, 0))
    rbt.delay(0.2)
assumptions: Explicit collision geometry declaration. No sensed grasp and no attached physical payload are inferred.
